primary_support_definition.geometry: standard NEON 10x10 only; SRER excluded from primary
primary_support_definition.completeness_rule: gridCompletion values across the bout must equal only 'setting complete, processing complete'
primary_support_definition.taxonomy_conflict_rule: if the same plot x eventID x tagID is associated with more than one taxonID, exclude that individual from W/B repeat support for that event
primary_support_definition.species_group_rule: published NEON composite/speciesGroup taxon concepts are retained as taxon concepts rather than forced to species
primary_support_definition.repeat_support_definition: conflict-free tagged individual with coordinate-bearing captures on at least 2 distinct trapping nights within the same complete exact-3-night plot-event

no_relaxation_rules: do not admit incomplete bouts to make the gate pass
do not retain within-event taxon-conflict individuals to make the gate pass
do not pool one-, two-, or four-plus-night events
do not include SRER under the standard 10x10 calibration
do not widen the temporal session
